ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: Day 19 of the cycle, trend intact above a rising 10-day average, weekly aligned.
ladder.next: Hold; first warning would be losing the 10-day average, bigger warning is a daily momentum cross down.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 19).
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 趋势完好——持有；可在回调至 10 日均线附近时加仓。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 19 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 19 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 12 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked mid-way — a neutral, balanced structure.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在中段见顶——结构中性、均衡。

ladder.why_zh: 周期第 19 天，趋势完好并位于向上的 10 日均线之上，周线一致。
ladder.next_zh: 持有；首个预警是失守 10 日均线，更大的预警是日线动量向下交叉。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉；3 日线向上交叉（投资者周期第 12 周 · 日线周期第 19 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-11), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score +55/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-11），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 +55/100）。
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: The Weyerhaeuser Company is an American timberland company which owns approximately 10,400,000 acres of timberlands in the U.S., and manages an additional 14,000,000 acres of timberlands under long-term licenses in Canada. The company has manufactured wood products for over a century.
profile.description_zh: Weyerhaeuser Company 是一家美国林地公司，在美国拥有约1040万英亩林地，并在加拿大通过长期许可管理额外1400万英亩林地。公司已制造木制品超过一个世纪。
